pairs.subject: windowed-inference-over-oversized-inputs
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/Console.tsx:1 This context is a React layer and route frame for the desktop console. It runs no fixed-input-size model over an oversized input, so windowed inference does not apply; a case-insensitive grep of the console directory for inference|stitch|blend|accelerator|gpu|tensor|onnx|overlap|sliding window found nothing, and a git grep for the same terms across apps/ and packages/ found nothing either.

pairs.subject: windowed-inference-over-oversized-inputs
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/windows/main/console/ListEngine.tsx:4 The only 'windowing' in this context is DOM list virtualisation through useWindowedRows (only the visible rows are mounted). No model is run over windows, and nothing is blended or stitched. A grep of the console directory for inference|stitch|blend|accelerator|gpu|tensor|onnx|overlap|sliding window found nothing.
